info.title: MyLists Api
info.description: MyLists Api provides external access to the Api written for the My Lists Web application. Does everything associated with getting part information and working with lists

get.summary:
Gets all parts from the list. If the start index and numberOfParts are entered, then it will limit the request
appropriately

parameters.description: OAuth Bearer Token. Please see<a href= "https://developer.digikey.com/documentation/oauth" target= "_blank" > OAuth 2.0 Documentation </a > page for more info.

parameters.description: The Client Id for your app.

parameters.description: The id of the list that you want information for

parameters.name: countryIso
parameters.description: Desired country

parameters.name: currencyIso
parameters.description: Desired currency

parameters.name: languageIso
parameters.description: Desired language

parameters.name: startIndex
parameters.description: Where in the list you would like to start at

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many parts you would like returned back

parameters.name: assemblies
parameters.description: The amount of units you want for every part entered. Cannot be less than 1

parameters.name: includeAttrition
parameters.description:
The listSetting in the database will be used if the value is false. If true it will
include attrition
